title: Sughra ko akele chod ke na jana
body:
Mere Baba jaan (4)
Mere pyare Baba Mere pyare Baba
Sugra Ko akele chord k na Jaana
Mere pyare Baba Mere pyare Baba
1) Tumhare bin mere aye Baba, koi bhi aasra nahi hai
Tumhare bin rahu Akeli, ye mujhme hausla nahi hai
Durr yu'n na hone, ka karo bahana
2) Ghame Judaai ka Mai Alam, batau'n tumko kaise Baba
Laga hai zakhm dil pe mere, dikhaun tumko kaise Baba
Baba apni beti, Ko na tum bhulana
3) Karungi Mai duae'n Dilse, ba khariyat Safar ki Baba
Koi na hogi tumko ezza, Tumhari beti ka hai Waada
Mehmilon me mujhko, tum nahi bithana
4) Safar me hai mera ye Waada, Paresha'n Mai nahi karungi
Tamam kunbe ka aye Baba, khayaal Dil se Mai rakhungi
Tum jagah kanizo'n, me mujhe dilana
5) Chalungi saath gar tumhare, rahega paas mere Asgher
Khilaungi gale lagakar, Jo royega mera baradar
Gardisho se mere, bhai Ko bachana
6) Duae'n Karti hu Mai Baba, Rahe Amaa khuda ki tumpar
Hai aaj kaisa waqt mujhpar, Na waqt aaye ye kisi par
